title: Band at the Tuxedo and the 25, and clubs like Rice's
summary: He worked with John Kazman and a small unnamed band (Alcee, T-Ball, Albert Fernandez), and talks of Rice's and the Entertainers clubs.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
